meta.title: Pelican Riding a Bicycle - Master Vector Design Specification
meta.description: Comprehensive design specification and geometric blueprint for an SVG vector illustration depicting a joyful pelican riding a vintage retro roadster bicycle along a sunlit coastal promenade.

art_direction.mood_and_tone: Joyful, buoyant, humorous, determined, sun-drenched coastal breeze
stylistic_pillars: Mid-century European picture book aesthetic with dynamic character silhouette
Clean mathematical vector contours with varied stroke weights (1.5px to 5px)
Luminous gradients paired with distinct cell-shading for volume and tactile depth
Organic coastal breezy atmosphere with streamlined motion accents

svg_layer_manifest.description: Infinite coastal sky gradient rect, sunburst aura at (280, 90), drifting cumulus clouds
Ocean horizon at y=525, layered sea waves, miniature distant lighthouse/headland at left
Sunlit wooden boardwalk path from y=680 to y=800 with perspective plank gaps and granite curb
Graceful white motion streamlines conveying ocean breeze and forward velocity
Ground contact shadow ellipses under tires, drivetrain, and pelican bulk on the boardwalk
Far pedal (520, 525), far crank arm, far wheel rim/spokes inner arc, far fork blade
Right/far wing extended forward gripping far handlebar or balancing in wind, rear tail feathers
Far feathered thigh, far orange tarsus, far webbed foot planted down on far pedal at (520, 525)
Full rear wheel centered at (280, 600): tire, whitewall stripe, rim, 16 spokes, teal fender, chrome struts
Teal frame tubes (seat, chainstay, seatstay, down, top, head tube), chainring, chain, rear cog
Full front wheel centered at (720, 600): tire, whitewall, rim, 16 spokes, curved fork blade, front fender
Chrome seatpost, Brooks leather saddle at (390, 400), quill stem, cruiser handlebars, brass bell at (672, 295)
Woven wicker basket attached to front fork, silvery-blue fish leaning out with goofy happy expression
Pelican plump pelvis on saddle, proud chest at (525, 320), elegant S-curving neck up to head base
Pelican head at (560, 160), cap & goggles, happy eye, golden culmen beak to (765, 205), pendulous salmon pouch
Near thigh, orange tarsus descending to near webbed foot clutching near pedal at (440, 675), near crank arm
Foreground left wing curving down from shoulder (480, 320); primary flight feathers wrapped around handlebar grip (645, 320)
Specular glints on chrome, bell shine, water droplets splashing from fish and pouch, air streaks

qa_validation_checklist.check: Tire bottoms tangentially meet road baseline at y=710 (600 + 110 = 710)
Rear wheel centered at (280, 600), Front wheel centered at (720, 600), radius 110
Bottom bracket (480, 600), Seat lug (420, 420), Head tube (660, 340 to 675, 410) fully interconnected
Near crank (440, 675) and far crank (520, 525) diametrically opposed at 180 degrees, length=85px
Pelvis centered on saddle (390-400, 380-400), near foot on near pedal, far foot on far pedal
Culmen extends to (765, 205); gular pouch hangs below to (665, 280), creating expansive silhouette
Far elements behind frame, frame behind torso, near wing and near leg in immediate foreground
Flipped cycling cap, brass bell, aviator goggles, and fish in front basket with water droplets verified
